cow_nmc_v7_codebook.title: COW NMC Documentation v 7, Military Personnel and Total Population chapters
cow_nmc_v7_codebook.notes: Inner file NMCv 7/NMC_Documentation_v 7.pdf. Printed pp. 12-14 (PDF pp. 16-18) define intended Jan 1 active regular forces and exclude reserves, most paramilitaries, separately administered colonial/protectorate forces and insurgents. Source-date limitations are explicit: annual observations can approximate Jan 1. Population printed pp.31-35 (PDF pp.35-39) distinguishes UN estimates, census/reference dates, interpolation and historical borders. MILPER has no per-row quality code.

ZIM.military_service_notes: Native law mapping is an explicit approximation of the reported service system, not a claim that native recruitment percentages reproduce historical eligibility exactly.
